activity_checkins_seat_no_check.name: activity_checkins_seat_no_check
activity_checkins_seat_no_check.value:
("activity_checkins"."team_id" IS NULL AND "activity_checkins"."seat_no" IS NULL)
        OR ("activity_checkins"."team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_checkins"."seat_no" BETWEEN 1 AND 3)

activity_checkins_revocation_check.name: activity_checkins_revocation_check
activity_checkins_revocation_check.value:
("activity_checkins"."status" = 'revoked'
          AND "activity_checkins"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_checkins"."revoked_by_staff_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_checkins"."revoke_reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND length(trim("activity_checkins"."revoke_reason")) >= 2)
        OR ("activity_checkins"."status" = 'valid'
          AND "activity_checkins"."revoked_at" IS NULL
          AND "activity_checkins"."revoked_by_staff_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_checkins"."revoke_reason" IS NULL)

activity_checkins_verification_check.name: activity_checkins_verification_check
activity_checkins_verification_check.value:
("activity_checkins"."verified_at" IS NULL AND "activity_checkins"."verified_by_staff_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("activity_checkins"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_checkins"."verified_by_staff_id" IS NOT NULL)

draw_attempts_snapshot_check.name: draw_attempts_snapshot_check
draw_attempts_snapshot_check.value:
(
    ("activity_draw_attempts"."outcome"='missed' AND "activity_draw_attempts"."prize_id" IS NULL AND "activity_draw_attempts"."prize_name" IS NULL AND "activity_draw_attempts"."prize_cost_cents" IS NULL)
    OR ("activity_draw_attempts"."outcome"='won' AND "activity_draw_attempts"."prize_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_draw_attempts"."prize_name" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_draw_attempts"."prize_cost_cents" >= 0)
  )

draw_credentials_stamps_check.name: draw_credentials_stamps_check
draw_credentials_stamps_check.value:
(
    ("activity_draw_credentials"."status"='active' AND "activity_draw_credentials"."redeemed_at" IS NULL AND "activity_draw_credentials"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("activity_draw_credentials"."status"='redeemed' AND "activity_draw_credentials"."redeemed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_draw_credentials"."redeemed_by_staff_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_draw_credentials"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("activity_draw_credentials"."status"='revoked' AND "activity_draw_credentials"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_draw_credentials"."revoked_by_staff_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_draw_credentials"."redeemed_at" IS NULL)
  )

activity_participations_role_source_chec.name: activity_participations_role_source_check
activity_participations_role_source_chec.value:
("activity_participations"."role" = 'leader' AND "activity_participations"."seat_no" = 1 AND "activity_participations"."invite_source" = 'self' AND "activity_participations"."invitation_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("activity_participations"."role" = 'member' AND "activity_participations"."seat_no" BETWEEN 2 AND 3 AND "activity_participations"."invite_source" = 'invite' AND "activity_participations"."invitation_id" IS NOT NULL)

activity_reward_codes_redemption_check.name: activity_reward_codes_redemption_check
activity_reward_codes_redemption_check.value:
("activity_reward_codes"."status" = 'redeemed'
          AND "activity_reward_codes"."redeemed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_reward_codes"."redeemed_by_staff_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("activity_reward_codes"."status" <> 'redeemed'
          AND "activity_reward_codes"."redeemed_at" IS NULL
          AND "activity_reward_codes"."redeemed_by_staff_id" IS NULL)

activity_reward_codes_superseded_check.name: activity_reward_codes_superseded_check
activity_reward_codes_superseded_check.value:
("activity_reward_codes"."status" = 'superseded' AND "activity_reward_codes"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("activity_reward_codes"."status" <> 'superseded' AND "activity_reward_codes"."superseded_at" IS NULL)

activity_reward_codes_revoked_check.name: activity_reward_codes_revoked_check
activity_reward_codes_revoked_check.value:
("activity_reward_codes"."status" = 'revoked' AND "activity_reward_codes"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("activity_reward_codes"."status" <> 'revoked' AND "activity_reward_codes"."revoked_at" IS NULL)

activity_reward_grants_revocation_check.name: activity_reward_grants_revocation_check
activity_reward_grants_revocation_check.value:
("activity_reward_grants"."status" = 'revoked'
          AND "activity_reward_grants"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_reward_grants"."revoked_by_staff_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_reward_grants"."revoke_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("activity_reward_grants"."status" <> 'revoked'
          AND "activity_reward_grants"."revoked_at" IS NULL
          AND "activity_reward_grants"."revoked_by_staff_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_reward_grants"."revoke_reason" IS NULL)

activity_reward_grants_redemption_check.name: activity_reward_grants_redemption_check
activity_reward_grants_redemption_check.value:
("activity_reward_grants"."status" IN ('redeemed', 'disputed', 'reversed')
          AND "activity_reward_grants"."redeemed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_reward_grants"."redeemed_by_staff_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("activity_reward_grants"."status" IN ('granted', 'revoked', 'expired')
          AND "activity_reward_grants"."redeemed_at" IS NULL
          AND "activity_reward_grants"."redeemed_by_staff_id" IS NULL)

activity_teams_locked_at_check.name: activity_teams_locked_at_check
activity_teams_locked_at_check.value:
("activity_teams"."status" = 'locked' AND "activity_teams"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("activity_teams"."status" = 'open' AND "activity_teams"."locked_at" IS NULL)

ledger_entries_source_kind_check.name: ledger_entries_source_kind_check
ledger_entries_source_kind_check.value:
("ledger_entries"."fact_kind" = 'order_registered' AND "ledger_entries"."source_system" = 'local_order')
        OR ("ledger_entries"."fact_kind" = 'order_verified'
          AND "ledger_entries"."source_system" IN ('local_order', 'crm_service_order'))
        OR ("ledger_entries"."fact_kind" IN ('payment_received', 'payment_reversed')
          AND "ledger_entries"."source_system" = 'manual')
        OR ("ledger_entries"."fact_kind" IN ('reward_cost', 'reward_reversed')
          AND "ledger_entries"."source_system" = 'activity_reward_grant')

ledger_entries_attribution_check.name: ledger_entries_attribution_check
ledger_entries_attribution_check.value:
("ledger_entries"."attribution_state" = 'attributed'
          AND "ledger_entries"."attributed_staff_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ledger_entries"."attribution_basis" IN ('explicit_attribution', 'confirmed_fact'))
        OR ("ledger_entries"."attribution_state" = 'pending'
          AND "ledger_entries"."attributed_staff_id" IS NULL
          AND "ledger_entries"."attribution_basis" IN ('no_explicit_attribution', 'source_missing'))

ledger_entries_payment_evidence_check.name: ledger_entries_payment_evidence_check
ledger_entries_payment_evidence_check.value:
"ledger_entries"."fact_kind" NOT IN ('payment_received', 'payment_reversed')
        OR ("ledger_entries"."evidence_ref" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ledger_entries"."recorded_by_staff_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ledger_entries"."evidence_kind" <> 'none')

ledger_entries_counter_entry_check.name: ledger_entries_counter_entry_check
ledger_entries_counter_entry_check.value:
("ledger_entries"."fact_kind" IN ('payment_reversed', 'reward_reversed')
          AND "ledger_entries"."counter_entry_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("ledger_entries"."fact_kind" NOT IN ('payment_reversed', 'reward_reversed')
          AND "ledger_entries"."counter_entry_id" IS NULL)

ledger_entries_verified_at_check.name: ledger_entries_verified_at_check
ledger_entries_verified_at_check.value:
("ledger_entries"."fact_kind" = 'order_verified' AND "ledger_entries"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("ledger_entries"."fact_kind" <> 'order_verified' AND "ledger_entries"."verified_at" IS NULL)

reconciliation_batches_lock_check.name: reconciliation_batches_lock_check
reconciliation_batches_lock_check.value:
("reconciliation_batches"."status" = 'locked'
          AND "reconciliation_batches"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "reconciliation_batches"."locked_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("reconciliation_batches"."status" = 'open'
          AND "reconciliation_batches"."locked_at" IS NULL
          AND "reconciliation_batches"."locked_by_user_id" IS NULL
          AND "reconciliation_batches"."locked_by_staff_id" IS NULL)

resident_phone_identities_phone_check.name: resident_phone_identities_phone_check
resident_phone_identities_phone_check.value:
length("resident_phone_identities"."phone") = 11
        AND "resident_phone_identities"."phone" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
        AND substr("resident_phone_identities"."phone", 1, 1) = '1'
        AND substr("resident_phone_identities"."phone", 2, 1) BETWEEN '3' AND '9'

wechat_oauth_configs_app_id_check.name: wechat_oauth_configs_app_id_check
wechat_oauth_configs_app_id_check.value:
length("wechat_oauth_configs"."app_id") BETWEEN 6 AND 64
        AND "wechat_oauth_configs"."app_id" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9]*'

wechat_oauth_configs_key_id_check.name: wechat_oauth_configs_key_id_check
wechat_oauth_configs_key_id_check.value:
length("wechat_oauth_configs"."key_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 32
        AND "wechat_oauth_configs"."key_id" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9._-]*'

wechat_oauth_configs_lifecycle_check.name: wechat_oauth_configs_lifecycle_check
wechat_oauth_configs_lifecycle_check.value:
("wechat_oauth_configs"."status" = 'active'
          AND "wechat_oauth_configs"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "wechat_oauth_configs"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "wechat_oauth_configs"."retired_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("wechat_oauth_configs"."status" = 'retired'
          AND "wechat_oauth_configs"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("wechat_oauth_configs"."status" = 'verified'
          AND "wechat_oauth_configs"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "wechat_oauth_configs"."activated_at" IS NULL
          AND "wechat_oauth_configs"."retired_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("wechat_oauth_configs"."status" IN ('draft', 'failed')
          AND "wechat_oauth_configs"."verified_at" IS NULL
          AND "wechat_oauth_configs"."activated_at" IS NULL
          AND "wechat_oauth_configs"."retired_at" IS NULL)

settlement_parties_verification_check.name: settlement_parties_verification_check
settlement_parties_verification_check.value: (verified_at IS NULL AND verification_ref IS NULL) OR (verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verification_ref IS NOT NULL)

settlement_rule_rate_sum_check.name: settlement_rule_rate_sum_check
settlement_rule_rate_sum_check.value: seller_rate_bps >= 0 AND sanchuang_rate_bps >= 0 AND guangdian_rate_bps >= 0 AND seller_rate_bps + sanchuang_rate_bps + guangdian_rate_bps = 10000

settlement_rule_fee_check.name: settlement_rule_fee_check
settlement_rule_fee_check.value: processor_fee_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND ((processor_fee_bps = 0 AND processor_fee_owner = 'none') OR (processor_fee_bps > 0 AND processor_fee_owner IN ('seller','sanchuang','guangdian')))

settlement_rule_terms_check.name: settlement_rule_terms_check
settlement_rule_terms_check.value: fee_base = 'actual_received' AND rounding_recipient IN ('seller','sanchuang','guangdian') AND rounding_policy = 'floor_then_named_remainder' AND processor_fee_rounding = 'floor' AND reversal_policy = 'full_reversal_blocks' AND partial_refund_policy = 'unsupported_blocks' AND approval_status = 'admin_attested'

settlement_statements_money_check.name: settlement_statements_money_check
settlement_statements_money_check.value: line_count >= 0 AND calculated_count >= 0 AND blocked_count >= 0 AND line_count = calculated_count + blocked_count AND eligible_gross_cents >= 0 AND fee_cents >= 0 AND seller_net_cents >= 0 AND sanchuang_net_cents >= 0 AND guangdian_net_cents >= 0 AND eligible_gross_cents = fee_cents + seller_net_cents + sanchuang_net_cents + guangdian_net_cents

settlement_statements_review_check.name: settlement_statements_review_check
settlement_statements_review_check.value: (status = 'draft' AND reviewed_by_user_id IS NULL AND reviewed_at IS NULL AND locked_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('reviewed','locked') AND reviewed_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND review_evidence_ref IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_by_user_id <> created_by_user_id AND ((status = 'reviewed' AND locked_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'locked' AND locked_at IS NOT NULL AND locked_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND lock_evidence_ref IS NOT NULL))) OR (status = 'superseded' AND locked_at IS NULL)

settlement_statement_line_state_check.name: settlement_statement_line_state_check
settlement_statement_line_state_check.value: (state = 'blocked' AND allocation_json IS NULL) OR (state = 'calculated' AND allocation_json IS NOT NULL AND rule_id IS NOT NULL AND receipt_entry_id IS NOT NULL)

settlement_payment_record_money_check.name: settlement_payment_record_money_check
settlement_payment_record_money_check.value: payable_cents_snapshot > 0 AND amount_cents > 0 AND amount_cents <= payable_cents_snapshot

settlement_payment_event_kind_state_chec.name: settlement_payment_event_kind_state_check
settlement_payment_event_kind_state_chec.value: (kind = 'recorded' AND sequence = 1 AND state = 'pending_review' AND evidence_ref IS NULL) OR (kind = 'verified' AND sequence = 2 AND state = 'verified' AND evidence_ref IS NOT NULL) OR (kind = 'disputed' AND sequence = 2 AND state = 'disputed' AND evidence_ref IS NOT NULL)
